rawContent: Rev. Dr. Angela Parker will deliver United's Gustafson's Lectureship on New Testament studies Monday Oct. 24. Her title: "Catching God's Breath in the Age of #BlackLivesMatter." Learn more and register (it's free) at https://t.co/gIQmI430cj https://t.co/aJgJjRnp6Q

Based on findings from her recent book, Dr. Angela Parker will present United's 2022 Gustafson Lectureship—"Catching God's Breath in the Age of #BlackLivesMatter"—on October 24 at 7:30 p.m. We're excited to welcome Dr. Parker next Monday. Register at https://t.co/gIQmI43y1R https://t.co/PpgDkdA6f9

Dr. Angela N. Parker's Gustafson Lectureship on New Testament Studies, "Catching God's Breath in the Age of #BlackLivesMatter," was well received by a generous crowd of in-person and livestreaming attendees. Our thanks to Dr. Parker for joining us Monday night! https://t.co/bXgP58XFdI
